inspection.coverage_note: These are passages and model-definition sections actually inspected, not a claim that every sentence on each page or the entire PDF was read. Field claims are retained separately in field-evidence.json; legacy records remain unchecked reference material.

claims.value: Source-explicit SM/MSSM inheritance is expanded using the declared atlas baseline: three ordinary SM chiral families, no independent RH neutrino unless stated. Exact Dynkin and all-LH conversion are conventions/derivations, not newly printed source tables. Gauge connections and dependent conjugates are not extra matter.

GSM x SU(nv) x U1chi; two hidden flavours U,Ubar,C,Cbar fundamental/anti-fundamental, three neutrino singlets and complex phi. TableI is in common left-chiral SM q,ubar,dbar,L,eplus convention: chi charges -1/5,-1/5,3/5,3/5,-1/5,N=-1,H=2/5,phi=2. Table neutrino N is the left-chiral charge-conjugate coordinate, despite prose right-handed species naming: Majorana coupling NNphi is neutral. Retain table charges, do not conjugate this already conjugate coordinate twice.

Source explicitly specializes nv=3,k=0,qplus=-2; qminus=0 from qplus+qminus=-2. Uchi charges U=-2,Ubar=0,C=+2,Cbar=0. Joint full spectrum scales chi by5 and ordinary Y by6. One-/two-light-flavour mass regimes share microscopic matter.
